theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (M W : Set (Euclid P)) (V V₁ : Set (Euclid d)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P), IsOpen W → ContinuousOn ψ V → InjOn ψ V → ψ '' V = W ∩ M → (∀ K ⊆ W, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) → IsOpen V₁ → V₁ ⊆ V → ∃ N₀ : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen N₀ ∧ M ∩ N₀ = ψ '' V₁
